title: Almost global large deviations principle for the KdV equation
summary: We study extreme wave formation for the Korteweg-de Vries equation on the torus with random initial data of average size $ε$. We establish a large deviations principle for the supremum of the solution over arbitrarily long polynomial timescales $t \leq ε^{-n}$ for any fixed natural number $n$. This identifies the leading-order asymptotics of the probability of observing unusually large amplitudes.
